change.summary: Endpoints open for years began requiring a session cookie plus a crumb token, returning 401 with {"finance":{"result":null,"error":{"code":"Unauthorized","description":"Invalid Crumb"}}}. Rolled out gradually: intermittent first, then total.

changelog.note: Yahoo decommissioned its official Finance API in 2017. These are undocumented internal endpoints reverse-engineered from the website: there is no portal, reference or changelog in existence to watch. Silent by construction, which makes this weaker evidence than a silent change on a documented API.

contract.note: 200 to 401 with a new error envelope. The wrinkle worth designing for: the rollout was intermittent for a day, so a single daily probe could have come back healthy by luck. A useful detector samples repeatedly and treats a rising error rate as the signal rather than a binary flip.

notes: Four independent language ecosystems (R, Python, Java, Home Assistant) filed breakage reports in the same week. The crumb scheme was changed again in April 2024, so this is a recurring pattern rather than a one-off.
